```{r, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
full_hosp_truth <- load_truth("HealthData", 
                         "inc hosp", 
                         temporal_resolution="weekly",
                         data_location = "remote_hub_repo")


start_date <- as.Date("2020-07-27") # a monday
end_date <- as.Date("2021-07-26")

fips_code <- "US"

hosp_truth <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_end_date >= start_date,
                target_end_date <= end_date,
                location == fips_code) %>%
  mutate(day = wday(target_end_date), epi_week = epiweek(target_end_date)) %>%
  select(3:6, 12:13)

ht_day <- hosp_truth$value
ht_day_ts <- ts(ht_day, start = c(2020, 179), end = c(2021, 178), frequency = 365)

# create list of aggregation levels
agg_list <- list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1)

# Construct aggregates
ht_day_ts_ <- ts(ht_day, start = c(4,1), end = c(10, 29), frequency = 56) 

day_agg_ <- tsaggregates(ht_day_ts_, m = 56, aggregatelist = agg_list)
agg.names <- c("daily", "weekly", "2-weekly", "4-weekly", "8-weekly")
for(i in seq_along(day_agg_))
   names(day_agg_)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]
```   

``` {r extended truth data}
# an extra 1*(top agg level) of truth data to plot against forecasts
extended_truth <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_end_date >= end_date,
                target_end_date <= end_date + weeks(8),
                location == "US") %>%
  mutate(day = wday(target_end_date), epi_week = epiweek(target_end_date)) %>%
  select(3:6, 12:13)

long_truth <- rbind(hosp_truth, extended_truth)

long_ts <- ts(long_truth$value, start = c(4,1), end = c(11, 29), frequency = 56) 

long_aggs <- tsaggregates(long_ts, m = 56, aggregatelist = agg_list)
for(i in seq_along(long_aggs))
   names(long_aggs)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]

for(i in seq_along(day_agg_))
   names(day_agg_)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]

periods <- as.double(diff.Date(c(start_date, end_date)))/56

dates_actual_agg <- rep(start_date - weeks(1), floor(periods))
for (i in 1:length(dates_actual_agg)) {
  dates_actual_agg[i] <- start_date + (i-1)*weeks(8)
}
plot(day_agg_, main="Covid-19 Inc Hosp", xaxt = "n")
axis(1, at=4:9, labels = dates_actual_agg, line = 1.1)
```
```{r base forecasts}
# vector of actual dates
dates_actual_forecast <- rep(start_date - weeks(1), floor(periods) + 1)
for (i in 1:length(dates_actual_forecast)) {
  dates_actual_forecast[i] <- start_date + (i-1)*weeks(8)
}

# Compute base forecasts
base_fc_day <- list(); fits <- list()
pi_levels <- c(10 * (1:9), 95, 98)
 for(i in seq_along(day_agg_)){
   base_fc_day[[i]] <- forecast(auto.arima(day_agg_[[i]]), h=frequency(day_agg_[[i]]), level = pi_levels)
   fits[[i]] <- auto.arima(day_agg_[[i]]) 
   # SARIMA(0,1,0)(1,0,0)[56]; ARIMA(1,1,0); AR(2) w/ non-zero mean; AR(1)
   # of course these change depending on the data
 }
```


```{r}
nsim <- 10000
h <- frequency(day_agg_[[1]]) # 56
sim <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nsim, ncol = h)
arima_fit <- auto.arima(day_agg_[[1]])
# simulate.Arima(arima_fit, nsim = h)

for (i in 1:nsim) {
    try(sim[i, ] <- simulate.Arima(arima_fit, nsim = h), silent = TRUE)
}

apply(sim, 2, median) 
# sanity check: converges to mean generated by forecast() as nsim goes to infinity

# apply(sim, 2, quantile, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
```


``` {r reconciled forecasts}
# Reconcile forecasts
reconciled_fc_day <- reconcilethief(base_fc_day, aggregatelist = agg_list)

# Plot forecasts before and after reconciliation
par(mfrow=c(3,2), mai=c(0.35,0.5,0.35,0.35))
for(i in seq_along(base_fc_day))
{ # This code is not optimized for plotting when there are many levels
  plot(reconciled_fc_day[[i]], main=agg.names[i], shadecols = c("light gray", "#C2DDEE", "#00458F") , 
       xaxt = "n", #axes = FALSE,
       ylim = c(0, max(reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$x, reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$upper))) 
  lines(reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$mean, col=4, lwd=2) # plots blue reconciled forecasts line
  lines(base_fc_day[[i]]$mean, col='red') # plots red mean line
  lines(long_aggs[[i]], col='black', lwd=1.5, lty = "dotted")
  axis(1, at=4:10, labels = dates_actual_forecast)
  axis(2)
}
points(base_fc_day[[5]]$mean, col= 'red')
```


Turn Reconciled Forecasts List into Tibble of Forecasts
```{r}
# Lower Forecasts
low_fc <- as_tibble(reconciled_fc_day[[1]][["lower"]]) # Change TS object to tibble
low_fc[low_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0
  
old_col_names <- colnames(low_fc)
new_col_names <- rep("string", length(old_col_names))
for (i in 1:length(old_col_names)) {
  new_col_names[i] <- as.character(((100-pi_levels[i])/2)/100)
  # new_col_names[i] <- ifelse(str_length(new_col_names[i]) <= 4, 
  #                            paste(new_col_names[i], "0", sep=""), new_col_names[i])
}

colnames(low_fc) <- c(new_col_names)

# Higher Forecasts
high_fc <- as_tibble(reconciled_fc_day[[1]][[6]]) # Change TS object to tibble
high_fc[high_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0
  
old_col_names <- colnames(high_fc)
new_col_names <- rep("string", length(old_col_names))
for (i in 1:length(old_col_names)) {
  new_col_names[i] <- as.character((100-((100-pi_levels[i])/2))/100)
  # new_col_names[i] <- ifelse(str_length(new_col_names[i]) <= 4, 
  #                            paste(new_col_names[i], "0", sep=""), new_col_names[i])
}

colnames(high_fc) <- c(new_col_names)

# Point Forecasts
point_fc <- as_tibble(reconciled_fc_day[[1]][[4]]) %>% # Change TS object to tibble
  transmute(`0.5`= as.numeric(x))
point_fc[point_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0

model_name = "base_arima"
# Join forecasts together
reconciled_forecasts <- cbind(low_fc, point_fc, high_fc) %>%
  mutate(forecast_date = end_date, 
         horizon = as.numeric(rownames(low_fc)),
         temporal_resolution = "day",
         target_end_date = forecast_date + days(horizon)) %>%
  pivot_longer(1:23, "quantile", "value") %>%
  arrange(target_end_date, quantile) %>%
  mutate(model = model_name,
         location = fips_code, 
         type = "quantile",
         target_variable = "inc hosp",
         quantile = as.numeric(quantile)) %>%
  select(model, location, forecast_date, horizon, temporal_resolution, 
         target_variable, target_end_date, type, quantile, value) %>%
  left_join(filter(hub_locations, fips == fips_code), by = c("location" = "fips"))

```





Turn Reconciled Forecasts List into Tibble of Forecasts
```{r}
#rec_fc_list 
model_name = "base_arima"

transform_to_hub_df <- function(forecast_list, model_name = "model", fips_code) {
  # If forecast_list == NULL, stop "you have not provided any forecasts"
  # if forecast_list is not a list of forecasts, stop "Please provide a list of forecasts"
  # if fips_code == NULL, stop "you have not provided a"
  # if fips_code! %in% state_fips_codes, stop "Please provide the fips code of a US location"
    
  thief_forecast <- forecast_list
  model_name <- model_name
  fips_code <- fips_code

  # Lower Forecasts
  low_fc <- as_tibble(thief_forecast[[1]][["lower"]]) # Change TS object to tibble
  low_fc[low_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0
    
  old_col_names <- colnames(low_fc)
  new_col_names <- rep("string", length(old_col_names))
  for (i in 1:length(old_col_names)) {
    new_col_names[i] <- as.character(((100-pi_levels[i])/2)/100)
  }
  colnames(low_fc) <- c(new_col_names)
  
  # Higher Forecasts
  high_fc <- as_tibble(thief_forecast[[1]][["upper"]]) # Change TS object to tibble
  high_fc[high_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0
    
  old_col_names <- colnames(high_fc)
  new_col_names <- rep("string", length(old_col_names))
  for (i in 1:length(old_col_names)) {
    new_col_names[i] <- as.character((100-((100-pi_levels[i])/2))/100)
  }
  colnames(high_fc) <- c(new_col_names)
  
  
  # Point Forecasts
  point_fc <- as_tibble(thief_forecast[[1]][["mean"]]) %>% # Change TS object to tibble
    transmute(`0.5`= as.numeric(x))
  point_fc[point_fc < 0] <- 0 # Ensure all negative values are changed to 0


  # Join forecasts together
  hub_df <- cbind(low_fc, point_fc, high_fc) %>%
    mutate(forecast_date = end_date, 
           horizon = as.numeric(rownames(low_fc)),
           temporal_resolution = "day",
           target_end_date = forecast_date + days(horizon)) %>%
    pivot_longer(1:23, "quantile", "value") %>%
    arrange(target_end_date, quantile) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name,
           location = fips_code, 
           type = "quantile",
           target_variable = "inc hosp",
           quantile = as.numeric(quantile)) %>%
    select(model, location, forecast_date, horizon, temporal_resolution, 
           target_variable, target_end_date, type, quantile, value) %>%
    left_join(filter(hub_locations, fips == fips_code), by = c("location" = "fips"))
  
    hub_df

}

transform_to_hub_df(reconciled_fc_day, "model", "US") 


```
